name: H10_infestation_sage_dies_into_one_flying_insect
note: Infestation Sage: 'When this creature dies, create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token with flying.' The Sage (1/1) on the battlefield is dealt lethal damage and dies: exactly one Insect token appears, a 1/1 with flying, and the Sage is in the graveyard.
